trend: ASCI 'A Pill for Thought' (28 Oct): 60 of 61 reviewed nutraceutical ads broke the code
why: The biggest category story, not yet used on X. Gives people a quick checklist, which makes it useful rather than self-promotion.
text:
ASCI found 60 of 61 supplement ads it reviewed broke the ad code. The common problem: a study on one ingredient used to sell the whole product.

A 10-second check for any supplement ad: is the dose printed, and does it match the dose the study used?
